verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM officially documents self-hosting with Docker (docs-8) and on your own infrastructure (docs-4, docs-26). A release note fixing k8s probes (docs-28) suggests maintained Kubernetes manifests exist, but no deployment guide is shown for any target. missing for 10: an explicit Docker Compose guide, a Kubernetes/Helm guide, a small-VPS guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM support and guide, and independent hands-on reports of server deployments.
